name: Silestone
line: Our most popular surface: non-porous quartz in over 90 colours.
desc: Silestone is an engineered quartz surface made by Cosentino in Spain, and it's what most of our customers choose. It's non-porous, so coffee, wine, oil and lemon juice wipe straight off, and with quartz second only to diamond in hardness it stands up to everyday knocks and scratches.
facts: Over 90 colours in polished, suede and volcano textures

name: Sensa Granite
line: Natural granite, factory-sealed for extra stain resistance.
desc: Sensa is a select range of natural granites and quartzites chosen by Cosentino for their looks and performance. Every slab is factory-treated with a penetrating sealer, so you get the character of natural stone with far better stain resistance than untreated granite.
facts: Natural stone, so every slab is unique

name: Granite
line: Timeless, hard-wearing natural stone in endless colours.
desc: Craftsmen have used granite for thousands of years for its beauty and durability, and it suits traditional and contemporary kitchens alike. It comes from quarries all over the world, so the colour range is huge, and large-format slabs mean fewer joins on long runs and islands.
facts: Highly resistant to impact and scratching

name: Dekton
line: The toughest surface we work with, indoors or out.
desc: Dekton is made by fusing minerals under extreme heat and pressure, much as natural stone forms over thousands of years. It contains no resins, so bleach, oven cleaner and drain cleaner won't mark it, and it's more scratch-resistant than granite, which makes it ideal for outdoor kitchens and busy commercial spaces.

name: Marble
line: Beautiful natural veining, at its best in bathrooms.
desc: Marble has been prized for millennia, and no two pieces are the same. It's softer and more porous than granite or quartz, so it gains a lived-in patina over time, which is why we often recommend it for bathrooms, fireplaces and feature pieces rather than busy kitchens.
facts: Ideal for vanities, hearths and feature pieces

name: Corian
line: Invisible joins and smooth curves, in one continuous surface.
desc: Corian is a blend of natural minerals and acrylic that can be joined invisibly and heat-formed into curves, so worktops and upstands flow as one surface. It's non-porous and resists most chemicals, and unlike stone, everyday marks can be repaired.
